cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check for running containers
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' 2>&1")
print("Containers:", stdout.read().decode())

# Get env from docker
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("docker exec areloria env 2>&1 | grep -E 'SUPABASE\\|REDIS\\|DATABASE\\|FIREBASE' | head -10")
print("Docker env:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
